ios_app_store.title: Chess Tactics Master
ios_app_store.subtitle: Learn Chess Through Puzzles
ios_app_store.description:
Master chess tactics and improve your game with Chess Tactics Master!

✨ FEATURES

🎯 Tactical Puzzles
Solve 1000+ puzzles ranging from beginner to advanced levels. Improve your tactical vision and decision-making skills.

🤖 CPU Opponents
Challenge multiple AI difficulty levels and see how your rating compares.

🌍 Online Multiplayer
Play real-time matches against players worldwide with our dynamic ELO rating system. Climb the leaderboards and earn achievements.

📊 Rating System
Track your progress with our comprehensive ELO rating system. See how you stack up against other players globally.

📱 Customization
Choose from multiple board themes, piece styles, and app themes including dark mode.

🔔 Real-time Notifications
Get instant updates on match invitations, game turns, and achievements.

⭐ Premium Features
Unlock unlimited puzzles, advanced analysis tools, and ad-free experience with our subscription plans.

🏆 Achievements & Leaderboards
Unlock achievements and compete on global leaderboards for different game types.

📖 Educational
Learn chess fundamentals through interactive tutorials and guided puzzles.

WHETHER YOU'RE A BEGINNER OR AN EXPERIENCED PLAYER, CHESS TACTICS MASTER HELPS YOU IMPROVE YOUR GAME ONE PUZZLE AT A TIME.

FREE TO DOWNLOAD with optional in-app purchases for premium features.

Questions? Contact us at support@chessmaster.app
